# axm subagents uninstall

Uninstall a subagent from agents

## When to use

Uninstall a subagent from agents

## Usage

```bash
axm subagents uninstall [flags] <subagent>
```

## Arguments

| Name       | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `subagent` | string | Yes      | Name of the subagent to uninstall |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                             |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Skip the 'are you sure?' confirmation                   |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Remove even if other extensions depend on this subagent |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would be removed without making changes       |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Remove a subagent you no longer need**

```bash
axm subagents uninstall my-subagent
```

**Check what would be removed first**

```bash
axm subagents uninstall my-subagent --preview
```

**Remove without confirmation (scripts/CI)**

```bash
axm subagents uninstall my-subagent --yes
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
